dialogue.grandline.greet.bandit: Your money or your life, stranger.
dialogue.grandline.greet.bartender: Welcome! Rumours are free if you are buying. What will it be?
dialogue.grandline.greet.blacksmith: Steel for the sea. Swords, guns, and repairs.
dialogue.grandline.greet.elder: Ah, young one. The sea has been calling you, hasn't it?
dialogue.grandline.greet.innkeeper: A warm bed and a hot meal — fifty Beli.
dialogue.grandline.greet.lighthouse_keep: Few ships survive what lies beyond that mountain.
dialogue.grandline.greet.marine: Halt. State your business — the Marines keep the peace in these waters.
dialogue.grandline.greet.marine_officer: Another face from the sea. Keep your nose clean and we will get along.
dialogue.grandline.greet.master: You want to learn? Show me your resolve first.
dialogue.grandline.greet.pirate: Heh, you look like you could use a drink — or a fight.
dialogue.grandline.greet.priest: May the sea be calm for you.
dialogue.grandline.greet.shipwright: A ship is a pirate's life — or a Marine's. Looking for a hull?
dialogue.grandline.greet.shopkeeper: Come in, come in! Supplies for every voyage.
fruit.grandline.bara.desc: Chop-Chop Fruit: split your body apart; immune to cuts.
fruit.grandline.gomu.desc: Gum-Gum Fruit: a rubber body. Its true nature awakens later...

fruit.grandline.kaze.desc: ORIGINAL — Gale-Gale Fruit: become the wind. Fills sails, cuts with air, raises cyclones (Logia).
fruit.grandline.mera.desc: Flame-Flame Fruit: become and control fire (Logia).

fruit.grandline.ope.desc: Op-Op Fruit: create a ROOM and rearrange anything inside it.

quest.grandline.bandit_trouble.desc: Bandits are raiding the island. Defeat 4 of them.
quest.grandline.execution_town: The Town of Beginnings and Endings
quest.grandline.first_steps.desc: Speak with the village elder at the shrine.
quest.grandline.first_voyage.desc: Sail to another named island of your Blue.
quest.grandline.path_bounty_hunter.desc: Arrest two pirates with seastone cuffs.
quest.grandline.path_choice.desc: Return to the elder and choose your path in this world.
quest.grandline.path_marine.desc: Serve justice: defeat 5 pirates and 5 bandits.
quest.grandline.path_revolutionary.desc: Strike at Cipher Pol and travel the seas.
quest.grandline.reverse_mountain.desc: Climb Reverse Mountain and reach the Twin Capes.
quest.grandline.shipwrights_favor.desc: Talk to the shipwright and get your first ship.
quest.grandline.whisky_welcome.desc: Reach Whisky Peak and survive its hospitality.
race.grandline.abyssal.desc: ORIGINAL RACE: deep-sea people with glowing eyes. Night vision and water breathing; weakened by bright sun.
race.grandline.emberkin.desc: ORIGINAL RACE: volcanic islanders with ember veins. Immune to fire; sluggish in water and cold.
race.grandline.fishman.desc: Breathes water, hits harder in the sea, ten times stronger than a human. Dries out in hot sun. Fish-Man Karate from birth.
race.grandline.giant.desc: Scaled giant (about 3.5 blocks). Huge health and reach, slower, crawls through small doors; cannot use rowboats.
race.grandline.human.desc: Adaptable and balanced. Can learn any style.
race.grandline.long_arm.desc: Arms with an extra joint: longer reach for attacks and interaction.
race.grandline.long_leg.desc: Very tall legs: faster, step over blocks, stronger kicks.
race.grandline.lunarian.desc: Black-winged people who can burn their wings. (NPC race.)
race.grandline.merfolk.desc: Unmatched in water (breathing, speed). Slow and clumsy on land; a fish tail appears when swimming.
race.grandline.mink.desc: Fast, agile beast folk with natural Electro. Can enter Sulong under the full moon.
race.grandline.reefborn.desc: ORIGINAL RACE: coral-skinned islanders who breathe water and regenerate while submerged.
race.grandline.sky_people.desc: Small wings let you glide by holding jump. Strong affinity for Observation Haki (Mantra).
race.grandline.starborn.desc: ORIGINAL RACE: star-freckled wanderers. Quick under the night sky and see in the dark.
race.grandline.stonehide.desc: ORIGINAL RACE: mountain folk with stone plating. Heavy armour and knockback resistance; slow, sinks in water.
race.grandline.stormwing.desc: ORIGINAL RACE: light, feathered sky-folk who glide on storms. Fragile but quick.
race.grandline.three_eye.desc: A third eye on the forehead. Exceptional Observation Haki affinity.
race.grandline.tontatta.desc: Tiny (under a block tall) but immensely strong for their size and very fast. Fits anywhere.
race.grandline.vinefolk.desc: ORIGINAL RACE: plant-blooded people with leaf hair. Heal in sunlight; burn easily.
race.grandline.whalefolk.desc: ORIGINAL RACE: huge, gentle sea people with blowholes. Enormous lungs and health; strong in water.
